content:
{'text': '夏莉·威廉斯（Hayley Williams）就前夫、新發現榮耀（New Found Glory）結他手 Chad Gilbert 於周日因癌病離世、終年 45 歲的消息發表聲明。', 'translate': 'Paramore 主音 Hayley Williams has issued a statement following the death of her ex-husband, New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert, who died on Sunday after a battle with cancer. He was 45.'}

{'text': 'Gilbert 今年較早前曾透露自己確診第 4 期腎上腺皮質癌。這位音樂人早於 2021 年首次公開表示自己正在對抗轉移性嗜鉻細胞瘤，那是一種罕見的腎上腺癌症。', 'translate': 'Earlier this year, Gilbert revealed that he had been diagnosed with stage 4 adrenocortical carcinoma. The musician first publicly shared in 2021 that he was battling metastatic pheochromocytoma, a rare cancer of the adrenal gland.'}

{'text': '「一直都不知道該說什麼，也不知道這樣說是否恰當，」威廉斯於周三在 Instagram 限時動態中發文寫道。「但我現在確信自己想說——因為生命是由我們所交匯的道路所組成，而我們交匯的原因卻是無窮無盡的。」', 'translate': '"I\'ve never known what to say, or if it\'s even appropriate to say anything," Williams wrote Wednesday in an Instagram Story. "But I know now that I want to — because life is made up of the paths our lives take that intersect, and the reasons we intersect are infinite."'}

{'text': '「Chad 無疑是樂壇的一位傳奇，與他相連的那段日子讓我學到很多，」她分享道。「他讓我認識了一些至今仍以美好方式塑造我人生的人，也讓我接觸到令生命更豐盛的音樂和文化。」', 'translate': '"Chad was undeniably a legend in the music scene, and the time our lives were intertwined taught me so much," she shared. "He introduced me to people who still shape my life in beautiful ways, and to music and culture that makes life fuller."'}

{'text': '威廉斯又表示，關於 Gilbert 對音樂界的貢獻，「該說的都已經說得差不多了」，並補充指「他對培育社群的熱忱令人鼓舞，至今仍深深印在我心中」。', 'translate': 'Williams added that "everything that can be said about his contributions to music has likely been said," and noted that "his passion for cultivating community was inspiring and will stay with me."'}

{'text': '「我會永遠感激他讓我對硬核社群及其文化有更深的了解與敬意，」她在結尾前寫道。「謹向他的家人、NFG 大家庭以及所有他的朋友送上愛與慰問。」', 'translate': '"I will be forever grateful for the deeper understanding and respect he gave me for the hardcore community and its culture," she wrote before signing off. "Sending love and condolences to his family, the NFG family, and all of his friends."'}

{'text': '威廉斯與 Gilbert 於 2008 年開始交往，六年後訂婚。兩人於 2016 年 2 月結婚，其後於 2017 年 7 月宣布分開。', 'translate': 'Williams and Gilbert began dating in 2008 and got engaged six years later. They married in February 2016 and announced their separation in July 2017.'}

{'text': 'Gilbert 在威廉斯之前曾有一段婚姻，他於 2020 年與第三任妻子 Lisa Cimorelli 結婚。兩人於 2021 年迎來女兒 Lily。', 'translate': 'Gilbert had been married once before Williams and married his third wife, Lisa Cimorelli, in 2020. They welcomed a daughter, Lily, in 2021.'}

{'text': 'Cimorelli 在 Instagram 發表感性的帖文，宣布 Gilbert「在睡夢中安詳離世」。', 'translate': 'Cimorelli shared a heartfelt post on Instagram announcing that Gilbert "passed away peacefully in his sleep."'}

{'text': '「他離開這個世界時，有朋友和家人陪伴在側，並如他所願，在妻子和母親身旁走完最後幾口氣，」她寫道。「他的突然離去令我們心碎震驚，卻又深深感激他能如此安詳、平靜地走完人生。」', 'translate': '"He left this world with friends and family by his side and, as he wished, took his final breaths surrounded by his wife and mother," she wrote. "We are heartbroken and shocked by his sudden departure, but deeply grateful he was able to leave this life so peacefully and gently."'}
